old_rule: First registered worker query_seconds included external independent oracle comparison
new_rule: Separate candidate reconstruction/query/output materialization from independent exact verification; report both, apply frozen <=2x preference to query execution only
reason: Frozen evaluation requires independently auditable cost components; common oracle overhead can mask candidate latency ratio. Verified harness inclusion, not a source/identity defect.
affected: All E2R query timing comparisons; preserve previous values as qualified, repeat matched builds/queries in new local namespace
approval: Targeted repair/revalidation under bounded local authorization; unchanged runtime caps/resources, no service replay or expansion
